mentions.name: Teilifís Seán (Jellyfin plugin)
mentions.description: A Jellyfin plugin that toggles Jellyfin between a Netflix-style presentation and an old school TV channel surfing mode at the click of a button, and back again. It makes Jellyfin more fun by removing the complicated decision of what to watch — when unsure, the user clicks the Teilifís Seán button.
mentions.problem: Complicated decision-making when choosing what to watch on a Netflix-style interface.
mentions.audience: Jellyfin users who aren't sure what to watch
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Jellyfin Plugin: https://xn--teilifssen-04a4l.ie/ (https://teilifísseán.ie/)

Will make your Jellyfin go from a Netflix style presentation to an old school TV channel surfing mode in the click of a button and back again.
mentions.author: s_dev
